candidate_evidence.quote: FG001 is an investigational optical imaging agent administered as a single intravenous dose prior to neurosurgical tumor resection to support intraoperative visualization of malignant tissue under near-infrared fluorescence guidance.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No prior tumor-specific treatment, including surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or investigational therapy (i.e., newly diagnosed, treatment-naïve HGG).

coder_notes: Diagnostic fluorescence imaging trial; the only registered agent is the imaging agent FG001, so no pharmacological candidate. Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype is one of several eligible histologies (also IDH-mutant astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, ependymoma), named in the inclusion criteria. Gadolinium and temozolomide appear only in passing and are not registered interventions. PK analysis is planned after surgery without a stated sample type; FG001 is not a candidate.
